title: Compress Image to KB or MB Online Free
description: Compress JPG or PNG images to a target KB or MB size in your browser with no upload or signup.
requirements: JPEG and PNG inputs are supported up to the browser tool limits.
Enter a maximum KB or MB limit from the receiving service.
The output is JPEG and transparency becomes white.
steps: Check the output size before uploading.

faqs.question: Is my image uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Compression runs in your browser.

title: Resize Image Online Free
description: Resize images by percentage or exact pixels in your browser while keeping the original file on your device.
requirements: JPEG, PNG, and static WebP inputs are supported.
Use exact pixel dimensions when a form specifies width and height.
Keep the aspect ratio locked unless the receiving service requires a fixed shape.

faqs.question: Does resizing upload my image?
faqs.answer: No. Canvas processing happens locally in your browser.

title: Convert JPG, PNG and WebP Images Online Free
description: Convert JPG, PNG, and static WebP images in your browser without uploading the source file.
requirements: JPG, PNG, and static WebP are supported.
JPG output fills transparent pixels with white.
Animated WebP files are rejected rather than silently losing animation.

faqs.question: Is conversion private?
faqs.answer: Yes. The image is decoded and encoded locally in your browser.

title: Convert Images to PDF Online Free
description: Combine JPG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC images into a PDF locally in your browser.
requirements: Images become one PDF page each.
Fit, A4, and Letter page sizes are available.
The PDF is assembled on your device.

faqs.question: Does this add OCR?
faqs.answer: No. It creates image-based PDF pages without a searchable text layer.

title: Convert PDF to JPG or PNG Images Online Free
description: Render every PDF page as a JPG or PNG image in your browser with no upload.
requirements: The complete page is rendered as one image.
PDFs are limited by page, pixel, and output budgets.
Password-protected PDFs are not supported.
steps: Download individual pages or a ZIP.

faqs.question: Are embedded images extracted separately?
faqs.answer: No. Each complete PDF page becomes one image.

title: Merge PDF Files Into One Document, Free Online
description: Combine PDF files in your chosen order locally in your browser.
requirements: PDF pages are copied without re-rendering.
Files must meet the documented PDF limits.
Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first.

faqs.question: Does merging reduce quality?
faqs.answer: Pages are copied rather than rasterized, so their original content stays intact.

title: Split PDF Online Free: Extract or Separate Pages
description: Select PDF pages by preview or range and save them as a new PDF or ZIP in your browser.
requirements: Up to the documented page and file limits are supported.
Pages are copied so text remains selectable.
Password-protected PDFs are not supported.
steps: Select pages or enter a range.
Choose one PDF or separate files.

faqs.question: Can I select non-adjacent pages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter ranges and individual page numbers such as 1-3, 7, 12.

title: Compress PDF Online Free: Smaller File, Same Text
description: Reduce an image-heavy PDF in your browser while keeping text selectable.
requirements: Image-heavy PDFs benefit most from compression.
Text streams remain selectable.
The original document is never modified.
steps: Compare the before and after sizes.

faqs.question: Does compression affect text?
faqs.answer: Text is copied rather than rasterized, so it remains selectable.

title: Rotate PDF Pages Online Free, Left or Right
description: Rotate selected PDF pages locally and save a corrected document without uploading it.
requirements: Pages can be rotated individually or together.
Rotation changes page orientation without re-encoding page content.
Password-protected PDFs are not supported.

faqs.question: Does rotation reduce quality?
faqs.answer: No. The tool changes page rotation metadata rather than re-encoding the page.
